description: Run a public publisher revenue-readiness screen using directional public evidence. Audits ad stacks, ads.txt hygiene, consent readiness, PageSpeed metrics, and unblocked premium ad unit opportunities (such as Sulvo) to recover lost yield.

domain.description: Publisher domain to screen, for example example.com. Private/local targets, raw IPs, internal hosts, and non-standard ports are rejected.

metrics.description: Optional publisher-supplied metrics used for directional revenue interpretation.

monthlyPageviews.description: Actual monthly pageview volume. When provided, the yield simulator uses this scale instead of the standard 100k baseline.

monthlySessions.description: Actual monthly session count. Used with pageviewsPerSession to derive scale when monthlyPageviews is not supplied directly.

artifactsDir.description: Relative directory for optional artifacts. Absolute paths, current-directory output, and parent traversal are rejected.

compact.description: When true with JSON output, return the compact agent-oriented report shape instead of the full report object.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of audit collection tasks to run at once.

enableBrowser.description: When true, run optional Playwright diagnostics for rendered slots, provider-aware network/console errors, selected provider privacy-review signals, and bfcache signals.

enablePageSpeed.description: When true, request public PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals diagnostics.

includeScreenshots.description: When true with enableBrowser, save a full-page screenshot artifact using a relative artifact path.

partnerId.description: Optional referral or partner tracking identifier embedded in call-to-action URLs.

whiteLabel.description: When true, format the audit report as a white-labeled pitch presentation for ad-ops consultants/agencies to present directly to their publisher clients.

vertical.description: Optional publisher vertical used for interpretation.

name: run_publisher_revenue_audit
